verdict.rationale: Perplexity Computer is itself an AI agent you hand tasks to. Docs describe delegating complex, multi-step work: web browsing, sandboxed code execution, document creation, email, connectors and site deployment. They also cover human-in-the-loop approvals and clarifying questions. A community user confirms the in-product 'Computer' option in the perplexity.ai sidebar, and another notes being routed to Computer, though a Max subscription or purchased credits is required. Missing for 10: first-party docs describing the in-app delegation UI (the docs focus on MCP-client delegation), and independent hands-on reports of task results.
